description: This file contains utility functions for TensorFlow graph construction, specifically for creating placeholders, constants, negation, and addition nodes.

methods.name: Placeholder
methods.description: Creates a placeholder operation in the TensorFlow graph with specified name and data type.

methods.name: Const
methods.description: Creates a constant tensor in the graph with a given value and name.

methods.name: Neg
methods.description: Creates a negation operation for a tensor output.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Creates an addition operation combining two tensor outputs.
